description: This source file defines a custom Windows Forms control named ColorComboBox, which facilitates selection and display of colors within a .NET application. It inherits from ComboBox, populates with known colors, and provides mechanisms to set and get the selected color, along with custom rendering logic.

classes.name: ColorComboBox
classes.description: A custom combo box control for selecting colors, supporting owner drawing, color display, and known colors.

methods.name: ColorComboBox
methods.description: Constructor initializing the combo box with styles and filling items.

methods.name: Color
methods.description: Property to get or set the selected color.

methods.name: Fill
methods.description: Method to populate the combo box with known color items.

methods.name: OnDropDownStyleChanged
methods.description: Ensures the drop-down style remains DropDownList on style changes.

methods.name: OnSelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates the selected color based on user selection.

methods.name: OnDrawItem
methods.description: Custom rendering of each item, showing color swatch and name.
